name: onesa-ai-db-production
runtime_role_privileges: CONNECT, schema USAGE, table SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE; no ownership, DDL, CREATEROLE or elevated membership
tls: require verified encrypted connection; use provider-compatible sslmode, verify pg_stat_ssl before acceptance
estimate_excludes: tax, workspace subscription, extra backup exports, egress, HA, application services and worker
provisioning_order: staging first; production requires separate approval and staging acceptance
